result.title: ClickSight: An LLM Framework for Interpreting Student Clickstreams Through Learning Strategies
result.comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, 19 tables. Under review. Code: https://github.com/epfl-ml4ed/ClickSight-CEAI
result.summary: Digital learning environments produce rich clickstream data that can reveal how students approach learning tasks, yet interpreting these fine-grained traces often requires substantial expert effort. We introduce ClickSight, a framework for interpreting student clickstreams through learning strategies defined in the literature. Given a student clickstream and a predefined set of learning strategies, ClickSight uses a staged LLM-based pipeline to identify strategy-relevant evidence, assess adherence to each strategy, and generate an evidence-grounded interpretation of the student's behavior. We evaluate ClickSight across two learning environments, 365 students, and 12 model backbones using an expert-grounded quality rubric and an LLM judge calibrated with human-expert ratings. Our results show that ClickSight can generate high-quality strategy-based interpretations across different models and environments, with reasoning models performing more consistently than instruction-tuned counterparts. We further find that providing external clickstream-extracted guidance can improve interpretation quality for strategies that require precise quantitative information from the trace. By connecting fine-grained clickstreams with theoretically defined learning strategies and preserving the evidence underlying each judgment, ClickSight provides a flexible approach for studying student behavior in digital learning environments.

AI.brief_summary: ClickSight 是面向教育场景的 LLM 框架，用分阶段流水线从学生点击流中找出与既定学习策略相关的证据、判定策略符合程度，并生成有证据支撑的行为解读，在两种环境和 12 个模型上以专家评分和校准后的 LLM 评审进行评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先筛证据、再判断、最后给有据解释」的分阶段流程以及「外部抽取的量化提示可提升判断质量」的发现，可能为 VLM 推理中的证据筛选、判断可核查性与外部证据注入提供借鉴线索，需核查其证据提取是否真正约束后续判断。
